heroHeadline: US House Passes RSF Genocide Resolution 44–2; ICG Urges Quad Truce Push; Al Jazeera Documents El Fasher Atrocities
heroSubtitle: On Day 1126, the US House Foreign Affairs Committee passed a bipartisan resolution 44–2 recognizing RSF genocide in Darfur and calling for the RSF to be designated a foreign terrorist organization — Sudan's Foreign Ministry welcomed the vote. The International Crisis Group's 'Divided Sudan, Elusive Peace' brief (B211) assessed the Quad mediation landscape and called for a 3-month humanitarian truce, identifying SAF maximalism and RSF intransigence as key barriers. Al Jazeera's Fault Lines documentary 'No Exit from El Fasher' published survivor testimony documenting RSF atrocities in El Fasher post-siege — including civilians shot on escape roads and ethnically targeted killings of Zaghawa and Fur communities. These diplomatic and documentation developments come against a backdrop of escalating military activity: SAF drone strikes hit three locations in El Geneina (May 13, 2+ killed); the SAF-aligned government formally returned to Khartoum from Port Sudan (May 14); EU sanctions targeted seven conflict principals from both sides (May 14); and SAF's Al Zorg strike killed 64 civilians in Hemedti's North Darfur hometown (May 14). Sudan remains the world's largest humanitarian crisis with 19.1 million at IPC3+ food insecurity, famine in El Fasher and Kadugli, and the UN 2026 appeal only 16% funded.
